data.body:
Implemented as change https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1662 (commit 308215c677).

PREMISE VERIFIED in origin/main cc69cc1179. `classify_plan_review_attestation` (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/resign.py:485) discriminated three failure cases but its catch-all — reached for any non-material failure, including the lock timeout — never inspected `sidecar_emitted`, despite that field being present on the very result dict it is handed (set unconditionally at src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py:747, contracted in schemas/plan_review_verdict.schema.json:83). Confirmed real, exactly one missing discriminator.

CHANGE. New `ATTESTATION_SIDECAR_LOST = "sidecar_lost"` cause with `recovery_tool="review_plan"`, branching ahead of the catch-all.

DESIGN NOTE — the predicate is `result.get("sidecar_emitted") is False`, NOT falsy. Absence is not evidence: keying on falsiness would have reclassified every result that simply does not carry the field, and in fact flipped the pre-existing facade test at tests/interfaces/facades/test_plan_review_attestation_facades.py:152 from `sign_failed` to `sidecar_lost`. That test is now pinned by test_absent_sidecar_field_is_not_read_as_a_lost_sidecar.

The message names no recovery that cannot work: an earlier draft said "\`rebar sign-review\` has nothing to re-sign", which still put the string in front of an agent grepping for it. Removed — the text now names only `review-plan`.

EVIDENCE. 6 new tests in tests/interfaces/facades/test_plan_review_attestation_facades.py (11 pass in that module). Wider related suites green: 634 passed, 1 skipped across tests/unit/test_plan_review_resign*.py, tests/interfaces/facades/, test_bugfix_size_gate_ad0d.py, test_review_bot_retrigger_attestation_6a81.py. make lint and make typecheck (509 files) clean.

Also updated the MCP review_plan docstring (src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py) so the documented cause vocabulary includes sidecar_lost.
